title: Validate Event Search frontend security accessibility deep links and performance
goal: Run adversarial frontend validation for XSS accessibility deep-link refresh cancellation offline/permission states and representative interaction performance.
inputs: VERIFIED bounded Event Search backend-neutral core
outputs: executable first-party Node frontend performance probe
PR-enforced 16 ms p95 local frontend update budget
invariants: OPEN-013 remains unresolved and Case-link mutation is not implemented
no final query dialect index storage engine provider or persisted result model is selected
no third-party UI framework/runtime becomes a product-runtime dependency
CMDR-owned visual and interaction behavior remains first-party
security_properties: untrusted event/query content never reaches unsafe string-to-DOM sinks
tenant and permission state are never trusted as client-side security boundaries
CSP-compatible implementation is mandatory and Trusted Types is defense in depth
acceptance_tests: node E2E test traverses deep-link -> transport controller -> semantic shell -> bounded result renderer
hostile result content remains text-only and never creates executable DOM
permission denial clears prior result projections and masks query content
offline state remains semantic and non-executable
PERF-TGT-EVENT-SEARCH-FRONTEND-STATE executes in PR and remains <= 16 ms p95
runtime security adapter explicitly includes e2e.test.mjs while production coverage remains scoped to four executable modules

performance_budget.rationale: Event Search frontend is performance-sensitive and must preserve responsive state updates
metrics: frontend work stays within registered bounded performance ownership
no production Search SLO is claimed by frontend-only benchmarks

migration.rationale: frontend runtime implementation has no persistent data migration in this wave

rollback.strategy: revert this bounded frontend work unit without altering the verified Event Search core

definition_of_done: mandatory states and deep-link refresh pass
representative update benchmark remains within the registered budget
